title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-19
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy 1973 Tampa show, highlighted by a smoking Here Comes Sunshine and The Greatest Story Ever Told.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers crystal‑clear Charlie Miller transfer quality that lets the band’s fire shine through. Both sets are praised for their setlist flow and energy, with “Here Comes Sunshine” and “The Greatest Story Ever Told” singled out as standout moments, and Jerry’s guitar tone described as pure ear‑candy.

ai_rating.rationale: All five‑star reviews praise both the musical performance (standout songs, high energy) and the recording (excellent soundboard transfer). The show is consistently described as stellar, justifying a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller transfer noted as crisp and excellent; no dropouts or balance issues reported. Listeners describe it as “ear candy” and a perfect showcase for the band’s sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans love the setlist for both sets; the show is seen as a strong, cohesive send‑off for 1973 with smooth transitions and balanced pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone (Fender Red Knob) is highlighted as “ear candy” and praised throughout the show.
